_comment: Topic art for the Pinterest daily drip. Every page that gets pins maps to ONE topic; a pin may only use its topic's images. Photo rules (her call 6 Nov 2026, the Pinterest assessment; enforced in scripts/pinterest/quality.mjs photoIssue): free Unsplash licence (never Unsplash+), Pexels or Pixabay only; at least 1000px wide; no watermark (checked by eye, recorded as watermark:false); never a product screenshot; photographer, page link and licence recorded for each. Art rules: real wedding moments (a couple from behind or at a distance, courthouse steps, a city-hall hall, a beach ceremony, a shower brunch table) or styled flat-lays (stationery, rings, florals); daylight; ivory, blush, sage and soft gold; no office objects, legal symbols, dated decor or empty rooms. retired_images: photos taken out of rotation and why (their files stay only while a published or approved pin still shows them). pages.<path>.search: the searches the page answers; a pin headline carries one of them and its title starts with one.
